headline: 今日无新片，MobLand与生化危机领跑热度
headlineEn: No new releases today; MobLand and Resident Evil lead buzz
summary: 今日无新片上映，本周仅3部新片；电影端《生化危机：爆发夜》《大学炸弹客》热度居前，剧集端《MobLand》《航海王》《侠探杰克》领跑，悬疑新作《挖掘者》待映。
summaryEn: No new movies opened today, with only 3 new films this week. Resident Evil: Outbreak Night and Unabomber lead movie buzz, while MobLand, One Piece, and Reacher top TV; upcoming thriller The Digger is one to watch.

industryHighlights.text: 今日0部新片上映，本周仅3部新片定档。
industryHighlights.en: 0 new movies released today; only 3 new films this week.

industryHighlights.text: 电影热度由《生化危机：爆发夜》《大学炸弹客》《爱情假说》带动。
industryHighlights.en: Movie buzz is led by Resident Evil: Outbreak Night, Unabomber, and The Love Hypothesis.

industryHighlights.text: 剧集热度由《MobLand》《航海王》《侠探杰克》领跑。
industryHighlights.en: TV buzz is led by MobLand, One Piece, and Reacher.

industryHighlights.text: 《绿灯军团》《怪物：丽兹·波顿的故事》横跨电影/剧集榜单；《挖掘者》即将上映。
industryHighlights.en: Green Lantern Corps and Monster: The Lizzie Borden Story trend across film/TV charts; The Digger is upcoming.
